people.name: Candice Odgers
people.stance: Ally. Small average effects, risk concentrated in vulnerable children, against moral panic. Closest to our thesis.

people.name: Jonathan Haidt
people.stance: Respected opponent on mechanism. Agrees the worry is real; we differ on cause (screen time versus what the child carries in and what the feed does with it). Challenge only where the evidence lets us.

items.title: GTA VI Shouldn’t Spark a Moral Panic. It Should Spark New Rules.
items.summary: Making games safer requires regulating design, not just rating content.

items.title: Why Parental Consent Policies for Social Media Do Not Help Families
items.summary: This sensible-sounding idea fails parents by putting them back into a collective action trap. Platforms often propose it because they know it won’t work.

people.name: Catherine Knibbs
people.stance: Ally. Child online harm and trauma clinician. Never named beside our advice; her published work may inform it.
